queries.name: Activation steering exact
queries.query: "activation steering" OR "activation addition" OR "activation engineering" OR "activation control"

queries.name: Steering vectors
queries.query: "steering vector" OR "steering vectors" OR "control vector" OR "control vectors" OR "refusal vector" OR "safety vector"

queries.name: Representation engineering
queries.query: "representation engineering" OR "representation reading" OR "representation control" OR "representation steering"

queries.name: Hidden-state intervention
queries.query: "hidden state" AND (steering OR intervention OR editing OR control OR patching) AND ("language model" OR LLM OR transformer)

queries.name: Activation intervention and patching
queries.query: "activation intervention" OR "activation patching" OR "activation editing" OR "activation injection" OR "activation manipulation"

queries.name: SAE steering
queries.query: ("sparse autoencoder" OR SAE OR "dictionary learning") AND (steering OR control OR intervention OR "language model" OR LLM OR transformer)

queries.name: Feature latent concept steering
queries.query: "feature steering" OR "latent steering" OR "latent vector steering" OR "concept steering" OR "concept erasure"

queries.name: Safety refusal behavior steering
queries.query: (refusal OR safety OR alignment OR jailbreak OR sycophancy OR hallucination OR deception OR truthfulness OR toxicity OR bias) AND ("activation steering" OR "steering vector" OR "representation steering" OR "hidden state" OR "activation patching")

queries.name: VLM multimodal steering
queries.query: ("vision-language model" OR VLM OR "large multimodal model" OR multimodal OR "audio-language model" OR "speech language model") AND ("activation steering" OR "steering vector" OR "representation steering" OR "activation patching" OR "feature steering" OR "hidden state")

queries.name: Diffusion language model steering
queries.query: ("diffusion language model" OR DLLM OR "diffusion LLM" OR "masked diffusion model" OR "diffusion transformer") AND (steering OR activation OR representation OR control)

queries.name: Mechanistic interpretability steering
queries.query: "mechanistic interpretability" AND (steering OR intervention OR patching OR "language model" OR LLM OR transformer)

queries.name: Model editing internal representations
queries.query: ("model editing" OR "knowledge editing" OR unlearning) AND (activation OR "hidden state" OR representation OR vector) AND ("language model" OR LLM OR transformer)

queries.name: Reasoning and CoT steering
queries.query: (reasoning OR "chain-of-thought" OR CoT) AND ("activation steering" OR "steering vector" OR "activation patching" OR "hidden state") AND ("language model" OR LLM)

queries.name: Persona sentiment attribute steering
queries.query: (persona OR sentiment OR attribute OR style OR affective) AND ("activation steering" OR "steering vector" OR "representation steering" OR "latent vector steering")
